subject: dsa
title: Same Tree
summary: Walk both trees in lockstep. Each comparison-node pairs p with q and turns match or mismatch. Any single mismatch means the trees differ.
problem: Are two binary trees identical in shape and values? Compare them node by node in lockstep; each comparison-node shows the pair p, q and turns match or mismatch.

steps.caption: Compare the trees node by node in lockstep. Here p = [1, 2, 3] and q = [1, 2, 4].
Compare the roots: both are 1, so this pair is a match.
Compare the left pair: both are 2, so this pair is a match too.
Compare the right pair: 3 versus 4. The values differ, so this pair is a mismatch.
Done. One mismatch means the trees are not the same, so the answer is false.
